actualReadsAndExposure.ownOutputs: Source written from the code shown in authoring tool call; subsequent permitted read of source and record for freeze receipt.
actualReadsAndExposure.repositoryHistoryTestsReviewsPredecessor: Not read or exposed in this scoped turn. Frozen declaration files and retained contract prose were the only source evidence.
actualReadsAndExposure.toolMetadata: Read instructions and tool definitions supplied in conversation; shell/Python authoring and hashing tools used without repository inspection.

configuration.allocationEvidence: Explicit parent task allocation; no provider introspection performed.
configuration.tierQualification: Fast requested; no distinct service-tier control exposed to this author. Actual provider tier not independently verified.

freeze.method: chmod 0444 source and author record before curator review; permissions checked through own-output stat.
freeze.scopeControls: Read/write scope enforced by instructions, not an OS isolation or access-audit claim.

retainedExpression: Four public function signatures, three private referenced interfaces, and the exact type-only import mapping.
Native stable JSON formatting, signature protocol, default constants, observation key order, state fields, and exact reminder prose from frozen contract.
Ordinary map/join/sort/for-of, JSON.stringify, optional chaining, nullish coalescing, and in-place counter idioms. No novelty claim for retained expression.
discretionaryDesign: Keep all complete implementation and two private helpers in the one source file.
Use a signature helper so name and input argument reads precede JSON.stringify(name).
Use named local threshold, maxWarnings, observations, and previousToolCallCount; preserve specified evaluation and write order.

verification.performed: Manual comparison against six frozen contracts during authoring; source length/hash/permissions receipt only.
verification.limits: No behavioral execution or external source comparison under the delegated scope.

authorityAndState: Only caller-owned existing shared warning-counter/signature/streak fields mutate. No tool/provider execution, permission grant, persistence, logging, I/O, state cache, new hard loop limit, conversation, or streaming-ledger behavior introduced in source.
